boardOfTheWorld.title: Jones Mountain Twin Review — 2025-2026
boardOfTheWorld.evidence: Review identifies a 2025 157 cm physical board, while the article is explicitly framed as 2025-26 and discusses the 2026 Master Core and BComp Carbon/Flax updates. It reports strong ice edge hold, good carving/jump/switch/park versatility and easy buttering/pressing, with tip chatter at very high speed. The exact production-year marking of the ridden board is not independently established, so treat its ride impressions as season-adjacent corroboration, not proof of a factory J.26 sample. Its weighted score and sub-scores are not converted to the site's editorial scale.

theGoodRide.title: Jones Mountain Twin 2011-2026 Snowboard Review
theGoodRide.evidence: Updated through 2026; reviewer disclosed four days on a borrowed 159 cm demo in some powder, good groomers and varied conditions, but did not identify the exact manufacturing season of that sample. Reports medium/quick turn initiation, capable jumps and switch, good hard-snow grip, moderate powder float versus freeride alternatives, and some washiness through spoon nose/tail on very hard snow. The reviewer notes the 2025 basalt-stringer change and says 2026 changed little from the preceding ride. This is multi-season context, not an exact 2026 sample claim.

snowboardingProfiles.title: Jones Mountain Twin Review (page updated 2026-09-14)
snowboardingProfiles.evidence: Its disclosed 157 cm sample is identified as a 2025 board tested 2024-02-15 on mostly hardpack with icy patches, not a 2026 sample. changes.park: 6.5 -> 7.5, conservative editorial adjustment: independent ride descriptions repeatedly support jumps, switch and occasional park/jib use; keep below a specialist freestyle board.
changes.forgiveness: 6.5 -> 7.0, conservative editorial adjustment: softer tips, 3D shaping, accessible butter/press and forgiving jump landings are described; not beginner-easy or catch-free, so only a half-point increase.

unchangedCaveats.stability: Retained 8 but medium confidence: solid for resort/jump approaches, with tip chatter at very high speeds and less damping than the Pro.
unchangedCaveats.response: Retained 7.5: medium-to-quick turn initiation and good grip, but external scales differ and not all reviews are exact J.26 samples.
unchangedCaveats.float: Retained 7.5, low-to-medium confidence: reviews call it usable/moderate rather than a dedicated powder board; true powder exposure varies by test.
unchangedCaveats.value: Retained 8, low confidence: the untraceable CNY 5899 seed was replaced with the dated CNY 4553.20 conversion of the Jones Japan official 25/26 JPY 107800 tax-included listing. This is a Japan-region reference, not a China-market price or confirmed in-stock quote; China pricing remains unknown. The earlier Swiss CHF 579.95 conversion is retained as a historical comparison.
